text: Turkey, January 2021. An ambulance took Cemal to the hospital. His dog Bonçuk *ran after it.* She stopped at the hospital door — and stayed. His family took her home. *She came back.* Again and again. Hospital staff started feeding her. For six days she waited at the same door. On the sixth day, the door opened. *It was him.* They went home together. Send this to someone who would wait for you.
title: Six Days at the Hospital Door 🐕❤️
